scenes.imagePrompt: Quiet home hallway just before dawn in deep blue-green light. At the right edge, a forearm in a plain white sleeve seen from behind, hand hovering hesitantly near a closed bathroom door handle, a thin warm line of light under the door. A folded white towel on a wall hook beside the door. A simple analog wall clock with plain tick marks and no numerals at the upper left. Keep the center band (35-65% of the frame height) as a calm, empty dark wall for the headline. Soft cinematic photorealistic style, calm palette of deep green, light blue and white, gentle diffused light. Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or faces.
scenes.videoMotionPrompt: Image-to-video, vertical 9:16, 3 seconds, first frame is the Scene 1 image. Pre-dawn home hallway in deep blue-green light. A forearm in a plain white sleeve, seen from behind with no face, hovers near a closed bathroom door handle and pauses with a slight hesitation, a thin warm line of light glowing under the door, while the second hand of the analog wall clock at the upper left ticks forward. Camera: one slow, stable push-in of about 8 percent toward the hand and door handle. Timing: 0-1s hold on the opening frame with the clock ticking; 1-2.5s slow push-in as the hand hesitates; 2.5-3s settle and hold with the hand frozen just before the handle. Lighting: cool low-key blue-green ambient light, with the warm line under the door as the only warm accent. Composition: keep the center of the frame empty and end with the hand and door in the right third. No faces, no text, no morphing, no cuts, realistic physics.

scenes.videoMotionPrompt: Image-to-video, vertical 9:16, 3 seconds, first frame is the Scene 9 image. The same quiet hallway at sunrise: the bathroom door is open and warm light spills out as the window light slowly brightens from soft light blue to gentle green-gold. Camera: one slow, stable pull-back of about 8 percent from the open door, revealing more of the neatly unrolled prayer rug in the foreground. Timing: 0-1s hold on the opening frame; 1-2.5s slow pull-back as the light gradually brightens; 2.5-3s settle into a calm, stable hold. Lighting: warm soft sunrise, low contrast. Composition: keep the center and lower-center of the frame clean and softly lit for the CTA text. No people, no text, no morphing, no abrupt movement.
